# walk
# args .
# note a directory whose name begins with a dot is stepped over
>>> a.rr
a.rr
>>> b.txt
b.txt
>>> sub/c.rr
sub/c.rr
>>> sub/deep/d.rr
sub/deep/d.rr
>>> testdata/g.rr
testdata/g.rr
>>> .git/e.rr
.git/e.rr
>>> _u/f.rr
_u/f.rr
>>> stdout
{{root}}/_u/f.rr
{{root}}/a.rr
{{root}}/sub/c.rr
{{root}}/sub/deep/d.rr
